sources.note: Official Gilman Program homepage. States 'This is the official Gilman Program website', identifies the awarding body, and carries the 'Gilman app closed / Application Closed' notice with the Fall 2026 deadline of October 1, 2026 at 11:59PM PT.

Official Deadlines & Timeline page. Confirms the Fall 2026 cycle is closed (student deadline October 1, 2026, advisor certification October 8, 2026) and publishes the Spring 2027 cycle: opens mid-January 2027, student deadline February 25, 2027 11:59pm PT, advisor certification March 4, 2027.
Official Eligibility page. Lists the applicant requirements (citizenship, study level, Federal Pell Grant, credit-bearing study abroad or internship programme).
Official Program Overview page. States the award amount ('up to $5,000'), the 'high financial need' criterion, and the expenses the award defrays.

awarding_body.detail: gilmanscholarship.org is the programme's own official site ('This is the official Gilman Program website'), with footer links to state.gov/eca.state.gov and iie.org and official correspondence on the iie.org domain. It states the programme is a U.S. Department of State Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs programme administered by the Institute of International Education since 2001, exactly matching the record's awarding body.
awarding_body.quote: The Gilman Program is congressionally funded and named after the late Congressman Benjamin A. Gilman (R-NY). It is a program of the U.S. Department of State's Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs and has been administered by the Institute of International Education since 2001.

deadline.detail: The Deadlines & Timeline page confirms the record's deadline_label word for word: the Fall 2026 cycle closed (student deadline Thursday, October 1, 2026, 11:59pm PT; advisor certification October 8, 2026) and the Spring 2027 application opens mid-January 2027 with student deadline Thursday, February 25, 2027, 11:59pm PT and advisor certification deadline Thursday, March 4, 2027. The record's deadline_date 2027-02-25 matches the published future deadline exactly. As of the check date the programme is between cycles, which the record already states.
deadline.quote: The application deadline is Thursday, February 25, 2027, at 11:59pm Pacific Time, and the advisor certification deadline is Thursday, March 4, 2027.

eligibility.detail: All distinct claims in the record's eligibility_summary were confirmed: U.S. citizens/nationals; undergraduate students (two-year and four-year accredited U.S. institutions) with high financial need; receiving, or able to prove they will receive, a Federal Pell Grant; and applying to/accepted to a credit-bearing study abroad or internship programme abroad. The Program Overview page also uses the 'high financial need' wording verbatim.
eligibility.quote: To be eligible for a Gilman scholarship, an applicant must be: A citizen or national of the United States; An undergraduate student in good standing at an accredited institution of higher education in the United States (including both two-year and four-year institutions); Receiving a Federal Pell Grant during the time of application or provide proof that they will be receiving a Pell Grant during the term of their study abroad program or internship; In the process of applying to, or accepted to, a credit-bearing study abroad or internship program.

funding.detail: 'Partially Funded' is accurate. The standard award is up to $5,000 (nearly 3,000 awards per academic year) and is a capped defrayment of eligible costs - programme tuition, room and board, books, local transportation, insurance, international airfare, passport and visa fees - not full funding. Limited supplemental STEM and Critical Need Language awards exist on top of the standard award.
funding.quote: The U.S. Department of State's Benjamin A. Gilman International Scholarship Program (Gilman Program) provides up to $5,000 in merit-based scholarships to outstanding American undergraduate students with high financial need to pursue credit-bearing academic studies and career-oriented internships abroad.

degree_levels.detail: The programme is undergraduate only: American/U.S.-citizen undergraduates at accredited U.S. two-year and four-year institutions. No graduate level is offered. The new Gilman Skills for America Scholarship is also aimed at two-year college students (undergraduate level), so 'Undergraduate' remains correct.
degree_levels.quote: Nearly 3,000 scholarships of up to $5,000 will be awarded this academic year for U.S. citizen undergraduates to study or intern abroad.
